seo.title: AI Advertising — paid media in ChatGPT | Advia
seo.description: Ads inside the ChatGPT conversation, activated on the questions where the simulation says your brand is a relevant answer.

hero.titular: Your ad, in the conversation where your consumer is <key>deciding</key>
hero.lede: Paid media in ChatGPT, activated on the questions where the simulation says your brand is a relevant answer.

como.lede: The same simulation that measures your visibility tells when you will be a relevant answer. That is what the activation is built on.

items.desc: The simulations tell us where you will be relevant to your consumer, beyond classic keywords.
Different messages for different needs: the ad responds to what the consumer has in front of them.
During the campaign we see which messages work best and shift the weight towards them.

hermano.titular: The ad puts you in the conversation today. <key>AI Positioning</key> gets the model to mention you on its own
hermano.lede: We improve your organic positioning, making you the answer to lift the results of your whole media plan.

cierre.lede: You tell us the goal, we simulate your category's conversations and show you in which ones you can be the answer.
